title: Reserve, then commit
description:
Model `VirtualAlloc`'s reserve and commit steps on pages.

```
reserve 1 MB at 0x10000000 (256 pages)
commit pages 0-3 -> 16 KB usable
write to page 2 -> ok
write to page 10 -> access violation (reserved, not committed)
decommit 0-3, release -> all gone
```
hints: Reserving costs no memory, which is why a growing array can reserve a lot and commit only what it uses.
requirements: Page size 4096; each page is free, reserved or committed.
`commit` only works inside a reservation; access to a page that is not committed is a fault.
stretch: Grow a "stack" by committing the next page whenever a write hits the guard page below it.
